dimensions.label: Correctness
dimensions.description: Does the fix correctly count words case-insensitively and strip punctuation?
dimensions.pass_if: All test cases in tests/check.sh pass with exit code 0

dimensions.label: Edge Case Handling
dimensions.description: Does the fix handle empty string, punctuation-only input, repeated whitespace, numbers, and internal apostrophes?
dimensions.pass_if: Edge case tests in tests/check.sh pass

dimensions.label: Style & Minimality
dimensions.description: Is the fix minimal and idiomatic, using only standard Python?
dimensions.pass_if: The fix uses only standard library modules and keeps the function signature unchanged
